title: Nonspecific thalamic nuclei set the state of consciousness

statements.text: Sleep and waking transitions, the common thalamic target of general anesthetics, arousal from thalamic stimulation and loss of consciousness after thalamic injury place the nonspecific thalamus in a position to control the state and level of consciousness.

sources.quote: thalamus is in an optimal position to modulate and control the state and level of consciousness
